:::{#exm-well-conditioned}
#### A well-conditioned matrix

The [matrix](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix) $\matr{A} = \sbmat{ 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 }$
has [singular values](#def-singular-values) $2$ and $1$,
so $\condnum(\matr{A}) = 2$.
Its columns are [orthogonal](linear-algebra-vectors.qmd#def-orthogonal-vectors),
so a small relative change in $\vec{b}$
changes the solution of $\matr{A}\vx = \vec{b}$ by at most twice that relative amount.

:::
